diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs disproportionately repeat actions that have already failed to produce progress, especially clicks, no-ops/waits, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Tracking action-outcome recurrence and requiring a changed approach interrupts unproductive loops, improving progress and completion. Cost: small state-tracking overhead and occasional premature abandonment of a repetition that might eventually succeed.
policy_text: Track recent action, target, and observed outcome. If the same or materially equivalent attempt produces no new progress twice, do not repeat it unchanged: reassess the state, change the strategy or inputs, or stop and report the blocker. Repeat only when new evidence makes success more likely.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated-result operations total 1,485 on candidate/bad sides versus 224 on base/good sides: 6.63× as many and a signed excess of +1,261.
The +1,261 repeated-operation excess includes +639 clicks, +356 no-ops, and +277 scrolls, showing recurrence across multiple action types rather than one isolated action.
